gloss: to disparage; to speak ill of; to put down

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {貶|けな}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to disparage; to speak ill of; to put down; to belittle
definitions.explanation: To criticize someone or something in a way that makes them seem worthless or inferior. Implies unfair or unkind criticism rather than constructive feedback.

examples.english: It's not good to put down other people's work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貶|けな}して⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He's always criticizing other people's cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{褒|ほ}める→褒める：01204_homeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{貶|けな}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上手|うま}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧にいて⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: There's someone at work who's bad at giving compliments but great at putting others down, and it's a problem.

notes:
USAGE:
Always negative — implies unfair, unkind, or exaggerated criticism. Often contrasted with ⟦{褒|ほ}める→褒める：01204_homeru⟧ (to praise).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貶|けな}す (to put someone down)
- ⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{貶|けな}す (to disparage a work)
- {貶|けな}して⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (to always be criticizing)
- {褒|ほ}め⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧せず{貶|けな}しもしない (neither praising nor criticizing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{批判|ひはん}する→批判する：21993_hihansuru⟧: to criticize — can be constructive; not necessarily unfair
- ⟦{悪口|わるぐち}→悪口：12672_waruguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to speak ill of — focuses on talking behind someone's back
- ⟦{見下|みくだ}す→見下す：09911_mikudasu⟧: to look down on — implies contempt based on perceived superiority
